detail: TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'toUpperCase')
note: uom/Iso4217.ts's isIso4217 does code.toUpperCase() with no guard, and its callers reach it with undefined. From the ./vm surface that is a string-table index out of range. From ORDINARY SOURCE it was the OperandWidth desync, and in that path it runs inside preflight, outside executeBytecode()'s try/catch, so the raw TypeError escaped evaluateExpression() to the host. FIXED: parser/OperandWidth.ts omitted OpCode.DATE_LITERAL, so OPERAND_BYTES[95] was 0 and every scanner using nextInstruction() read the literal's constant-pool index as an opcode. The date literal in this source (4-14-01) is what desynchronised the currency preflight walk. __tests__/parser/OperandWidth.spec.ts now compiles real source with emitOpcode() instrumented and requires the table to reproduce the emitted opcode boundaries exactly, which catches an omission of this shape rather than only a change in the size of the enum.
